steps.u: Our Docker image for the API is 1.4 GB and builds take 9 minutes. Slim it down.

steps.r:
FROM node:22
COPY . .
RUN npm install
CMD ["node","dist/server.js"]

steps.a: Single stage with dev dependencies and the full node image. I will switch to a multi-stage build: install and compile in a build stage, copy only production dependencies and the compiled output into a slim runtime image, and order layers so dependency install is cached.

i.content:
FROM node:22-slim AS build
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci
COPY . .
RUN npm run build && npm prune --omit=dev
FROM gcr.io/distroless/nodejs22
COPY --from=build /app/dist ./dist
COPY --from=build /app/node_modules ./node_modules
CMD ["dist/server.js"]

reference.summary: Cut the API Docker image from 1.4 GB to 168 MB and the build from nine minutes to about 74 seconds with a multi-stage build onto a distroless runtime, cached dependency install layer and a dockerignore.

decisions.choice: multi-stage build with a distroless runtime
decisions.reason: the runtime only needs compiled output and production dependencies, not dev tooling
